topics.description: The Feeding Our Future fraud scheme involves the theft of $1.1 million from a program meant to provide meals to children. The scheme was allegedly perpetrated by Somali individuals in Minnesota.
Taco Bell is under investigation for an outbreak of a parasite that causes 'explosive diarrhea'. The investigation is ongoing.
A federal investigation is underway into a deadly shooting involving ICE agents in Maine. The incident has raised questions about the use of force by ICE agents.
topics.reason: Use of force by ICE agents
